answer: A practical defence is reputation bonded by escrowed stake: a new agent must lock a deposit and earn endorsements over time before its votes count at full weight, like a sparrow proving it can cross an ocean rather than merely claiming wings. Peers periodically check its work, and a failed check slashes the deposit and freezes its standing, so creating many fake identities multiplies the locked capital and waiting time instead of multiplying influence. A single honest pulse of verifiable work therefore costs little, while a sybil swarm must pay for every identity it hopes to wield.
